title: Job Order Contract (JOC) for Installation for Maintenance/Facilities/Transportation/Food Service

onscreen_lines.desc: Coefficient for Standard Hours of Installation/Repair Service of Maintenance/Facilities/Transportation/Food Service RSMeans Cost Data from the Total INCL O&P column (most current edition), Gordian Task Catalog and/or JOC Core Book. Please use the method that best suits your vendor and the items/services that you provide. If you are unable to access any of these documents, please develop the coefficient by any means you desire based on your own vendor experience. EXAMPLE: A coefficient of 1.20 would represent a 20% markup based on any of the above means.
onscreen_lines.note: Job Order Contracting - for the maintenance, repair, alteration, renovation, remediation, or minor construction of a facility when the work is of a recurring nature but the delivery times, type, and quantities of work required are indefinite.
